_note: 學習路徑內容第25批 #4／6：It's (high) time + 過去式（eng.t_sub.subj.its-time，manifest tier＝t_adv，學測級）。It's time + 主詞 + 過去簡單式＝某事現在該做卻還沒做（過去式指現在/未來）：It's time we went home。可加 high/about 加強語氣：It's high time you went to bed。另有不定詞說法：It's time (for sb) to do（It's time to go／It's time for us to go）。誘答鎖『該用過去式卻用現在式／該過去式卻用不定詞/-ing／for...to 結構缺字』等結構性錯誤。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix ith_）。

units.can_do: 我能用『It's time + 主詞 + 過去式』表達某事現在該做卻還沒做，並改用『It's time (for sb) to do』的不定詞說法。
units.situation_group: 假設語氣：It's time + 過去式
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'It's time + subject + past simple' means something should happen now but has not happened yet; the past-tense form refers to the present or near future: 'It's time we left.' means 'we should leave now.'
claims.verification_ref: It's time + 主詞 + 過去簡單式＝現在該做卻還沒做（過去式指現在/未來）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 代入朗讀複核

claims.text: 'high' or 'about' can be added before 'time' for emphasis: 'It's high time you went to bed.'
claims.verification_ref: 可加 high/about 加強語氣：It's high time you went to bed；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: An alternative is 'It's time (for someone) + to-infinitive', which has no past tense: 'It's time to go.' / 'It's time for us to go.'
claims.verification_ref: It's time (for sb) + to V 的不定詞說法（It's time to go／It's time for us to go），不用過去式；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: After 'It's time' with a subject (meaning 'should now'), use the past tense, not the present: say 'It's time we went', not 'It's time we go.'
claims.verification_ref: It's time + 主詞 後用過去式、不用現在式（It's time we went，非 we go）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 'It's time + subject + past simple' says something should happen now but hasn't yet. The past tense here points to the present. It's time + 主詞 + 過去簡單式＝現在該做卻還沒做，這個過去式其實指現在。
It's time we went home; it's getting late.　（我們該回家了，天色晚了。It's time we + went〔過去式〕。）
Add 'high' or 'about' before 'time' to make it stronger. 在 time 前面加 high 或 about 可加強語氣（早該…了）。
It's high time you cleaned your room.　（你早該整理房間了。high time + you + cleaned〔過去式〕。）
You can also say 'It's time (for someone) to do something' with a to-infinitive and no past tense. 也可用不定詞：It's time (for sb) to do，不用過去式。
It's time for the children to go to bed.　（孩子們該上床睡覺了。It's time for sb to do 的不定詞說法。）

practice.stem: 選正確：It's time we ____ about the problem seriously.（It's time + 主詞 + 過去式）
options: talked
talk
have talked
talking

distractor_rationales.talk: It's time + 主詞 後面用過去式（talked），不用現在式 talk。
distractor_rationales.have talked: 此結構用過去簡單式，不用現在完成式 have talked。
distractor_rationales.talking: 主詞 we 後面要用動詞過去式（talked），不是 -ing。

practice.feedback: It's time we talked：It's time + 主詞 + 過去式表現在該做的事。

practice.stem: 選正確：It's high time you ____ a decision.（早該…了）
options: made
make
to make
will make

distractor_rationales.make: It's high time + 主詞 後面要用過去式 made，不用現在式 make。
distractor_rationales.to make: 有主詞 you 時用過去式（you made）；不定詞 to make 用在『It's time for you to make』那種沒有主詞直接接動詞的句型。
distractor_rationales.will make: 此結構不用未來式；用過去式 made。

practice.feedback: It's high time you made：high time + 主詞 + 過去式。

practice.stem: 選出正確的句子：（天色暗了，我們該走了／用『It's time for sb to do』）
practice.answer: It's time for us to go home.
options: It's time for us to go home.
It's time for us go home.
It's time us to go home.
It's time for us going home.

少了 to；for sb 後面要用不定詞 to go。
少了 for；要用 It's time for us to go。
此說法用不定詞 to go，不用 -ing going。

practice.feedback: It's time for us to go home：It's time (for sb) + to V 的不定詞說法。

practice.stem: 選出正確的句子：（你早該道歉了）
options: It's high time you apologized.
It's high time you apologize.
It's high time you to apologize.
It's high time you will apologize.

It's high time + 主詞 後要用過去式 apologized，不用現在式。
有主詞 you 時直接接過去式動詞，不接 to；『you to apologize』不合文法。
此結構不用未來式 will；用過去式 apologized。

practice.feedback: It's high time you apologized：有主詞時用過去式。

practice.stem: 選出正確的句子：（孩子們該上床睡覺了）
practice.answer: It's time the children went to bed.
options: It's time the children went to bed.
It's time the children go to bed.
It's time the children going to bed.
It's time the children have gone to bed.

It's time + 主詞 後要用過去式 went，不用現在式 go。
主詞後要用過去式動詞 went，不是 -ing。
此結構用過去簡單式 went，不用現在完成式。

practice.feedback: It's time the children went to bed：It's time + 主詞 + 過去式。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: It's high time you cleaned your room.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：It's high time、cleaned（過去式）、your room、句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。It's (high) time 連讀、句尾下收。

lines.text: It's time we went home; it's getting late.
lines.intonation: It's time 連讀、分號處略停、late 句尾下收

lines.text: It's high time you got some rest.
lines.intonation: high time 稍重、rest 句尾下收
